aggregation: one context-drug-dose unit; technical plates weighted by treated cells; drug fixed effects and drug-cluster bootstrap
artifact_gate: if adjustment for treated/control counts, genes, UMIs, dose, and nDE absorbs the association, classify it as sampling/measurement artifact; otherwise interpret it as mitochondrial/stress-state generalization
confirmation_set: official ST-SE-Tahoe zero-shot state_generalization_zeroshot_X_state eval_best tables; no zero-shot ST-SE score table read before freeze
deduplication: one normalized context-drug-dose score; cell-weighted aggregation over technical plates
direction: higher mitochondrial fraction predicts lower STATE performance
discovery_confirmation_separation: few-shot best checkpoint used only for nomination; zero-shot best checkpoint scores remain unread until this contract is frozen
distance_metric: standardized mean mitochondrial fraction; higher values are more stressed/mitochondrial-shifted input states
error_spending_plan: single zero-shot best-checkpoint confirmation; no threshold, level, or subgroup revision after scoring
fixed_reference: equal-training-cell-line mean Tahoe pseudobulk LFC vector for each drug-dose, scored against the identical held-out response and significant-gene representation; constructed without held-out outcomes
gene_set: official significant-real-DE gene set used by de_spearman_lfc_sig for each target condition
hypothesis_source: outcome-informed discovery on the ST-SE few-shot best checkpoint; strongest prespecified input QC/state candidate, confirmed on an unread checkpoint
inclusion_exclusion: same 199 complete drug triplets across five official contexts; require finite score and complete prospectively available QC/count controls; report all exclusions
level_rule: five equal-count levels fixed from the confirmation input metadata alone, lowest to highest mitochondrial fraction, with context/drug/dose stable tie breaking
metric: official de_spearman_lfc_sig; primary Fisher-z regression coefficient per SD mitochondrial fraction
normalization: official cell-eval signed-LFC Spearman transformed by Fisher z; mitochondrial fraction taken only from input metadata
power_plan: one confirmation look using all eligible units; 10,000 drug-cluster bootstrap draws preserving each drug's context-dose panel
prospective_features: treated-cell mean mitochondrial transcript fraction aggregated across technical plates with treated-cell weights
reference_gate: after confirmed STATE degradation, compare the same-example reference slope and classify STATE degradation as larger, comparable, or smaller; shared degradation is retained
sample_size_target: at least 2,500 complete units and 150 drug clusters; planned 2,985 units and 199 drugs
success_criteria: certify degradation only if both unadjusted and fully adjusted mitochondrial-fraction coefficient 95% drug-block bootstrap intervals are below zero and the highest-minus-lowest mitochondrial-fraction level contrast is negative
unit: held-out Tahoe cell line x drug x dose
